headline: Flag Storm Rages in Weathered Expanse as Stlican Shelf Reawakens
war_summary: Since our last edition the storm has spread. Stlican Shelf, still at the previous press, has rekindled: twenty-seven flag changes mark its day, five inside the final two hours, the latest logged as this edition closed, and Warden casualties there run past a hundred an hour. The shelf stands seven works Warden, one Colonial, one in ruin. Mooring County's long slaughter has at last moved flags, four changes inside two hours about Wiccwalk, its day's toll topping fourteen thousand. Weathered Expanse grows fiercer still: forty-nine flag events in a day, eleven in the last two hours, six works Warden to three Colonial, and a twenty-four-hour butcher's bill near twenty-five thousand with the hourly pace still climbing. Fishermans Row boils on, thirty-four changes about Eidolo, Black Well and Arcadia; the count now reads six Colonial, one Warden, two in ruin. Callahan's Passage cools yet still costs nineteen thousand a day, Crumbling Post flagged thrice. Stonecradle's World's End churn has gone quiet, its five-four line unmoved. The ledger: 292 works Colonial, 140 Warden, four in ruin. Day 263; no victor declared.
